item.title: SkillToolset: turning a SKILL.md directory into capability the agent loads on demand
item.description: A complete tour of tool/skilltoolset in ADK Go v2.4.0: the five methods of skill.Source and its sentinel errors, NewFileSystemSource(fs.FS), the two preload modes (WithCompletePreloadSource / WithFrontmatterPreloadSource) and the reload closure, merging several sources with NewMergedSource, the SKILL.md frontmatter specification (including both allowed-tools spellings), and the three automatically injected tools list_skills/load_skill/load_skill_resource plus the XML inventory injected by ProcessRequest.

item.title: The MCP Toolset: Transport/Endpoint/Auth wiring and self-healing disconnects
item.description: A complete tour of tool/mcptoolset in ADK Go v2.4.0: the seven fields of mcptoolset.New(Config) and their mutual-exclusion rules, an in-memory MCP server for tests, the Endpoint shortcut for streamable HTTP, the auth.CredentialProvider versus OAuthHandler fight over the Authorization header, connectionRefresher retry semantics, plus toolset trimming and confirmation policies.

item.title: Function tools and streaming tools: functiontool.New, every Config field, and the context available inside a tool
item.description: The foundation of the ADK Go v2.4.0 tool layer: functiontool.New's generic Func[TArgs,TResults] signature, automatic schema inference (jsonschema rather than genai.Schema), NewStreaming returning iter.Seq2[string,error], the real semantics of IsLongRunning, what a tool can do through agent.Context, and the official agenttool workaround for the Google Search plus function tool conflict.

item.title: Module 3: The Tool System (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: functiontool and streaming function tools, the MCP toolset, tool confirmation for human approval, and the SkillToolset skill directory

item.title: AI Agents Finally Make Literate Programming Worth Trying
item.description: Literate programming has been around for 40 years but never caught on — because maintaining parallel narratives of code and prose is exhausting. AI agents change that equation entirely.

item.title: Locking Down Your Local AI Agent: An Agent Safehouse Review
item.description: A macOS tool that sandboxes AI agents like Claude Code and Codex, preventing accidental file deletions and credential leaks once and for all.
